params.name: accessor
params.description: The accessor object to be deleted.

members.name: tvg_accessor_generate_id
members.brief: Generate a unique ID (hash key) from a given name.
description: This function computes a unique identifier value based on the provided string. You can use this to assign a unique ID to the Paint object.

params.name: name
params.description: The input string to generate the unique identifier from.

members.name: tvg_accessor_get_name
members.signature: const char* tvg_accessor_get_name(Tvg_Accessor accessor, uint32_t id)
members.brief: Retrieve the original name string from a given unique ID.
description: Returns the name associated with the specified identifier.

This method is only valid when tvg_picture_set_accessible() is set to `true` for the Picture associated with the given `paint` in tvg_accessor_set() Otherwise, the name information may not be available.
members.returns: The corresponding name string, or `nullptr` if not found or unavailable.
notes: This function is only available within Accessor callbacks registered via tvg_accessor_set().
